_meta.notes: Community-derived planning guidance. Breakpoints are planning targets, not game rules. Missing characters remain explicitly unreviewed rather than guessed.
_meta.baseline: Raise useful abilities to 9 immediately; current account-wide uncommon project targets useful abilities to 17.
_meta.evidencePolicy: Targets require character-specific community evidence or a clearly documented mechanical breakpoint; generic rarity caps alone are not treated as recommendations.
